text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
B-But... if I buy this,
that live concert Blu-ray gets even further out of reach...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta hide this rough skin somehow...
It's all for the Blu-ray release... for the Blu-ray...!

Agnes Digital leaves the school store with a grimace.
It seems she's desperately putting up with her rough skin...
